period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the 'Statement of Financial Position as at 30 September 2014 (Unaudited)' and 'Statement of Comprehensive Income for the period ended 30 September 2014' blocks (distinct from the 'Consolidated Statement of Financial Position' and 'Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income' blocks on the same infographic page -- note the consolidated P&L is listed FIRST/above the solo P&L in this quarter's column layout, the reverse order from the 2013 quarters, confirmed by reading each block's exact header rather than assuming a fixed position). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Sep 2014' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Jul to Sep 2014' column (interest income 3,976,847,546; PAT 561,277,766; EPS 0.79) not recorded as line items here. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo). Also includes a 'Performance Highlights of BRAC Bank Limited' regulatory disclosure box (not present in this bank's other 4 quarters in this batch) whose Deposits/Loans/Statutory Reserve/Shareholders' Equity figures reconcile exactly to this filing's own solo balance sheet, confirming the box (and its ratios: AD Ratio, ROI, ROE, ROA, COD) is computed on the SOLO entity. Consolidated cross-reference (same date, cumulative, for comparison only, NOT used as primary): Total Assets 192,210 BDT_million, Total Liabilities 171,718, Total shareholders' equity (BRAC Bank Ltd) 19,559, Minority interest 933, Total equity 20,492, consolidated PAT-cumulative 1,795 (attributable to BRAC Bank Ltd equity holders 1,526; minority 80), consolidated EPS-cumulative 2.87. Balance sheet identity (solo) reconciles exactly: 161,673 (Total Liabilities) + 16,909 (Total Equity) = 178,582 (Total Property and Assets). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly. Paid-up share capital rose sharply from BDT 4,433mn (March 2014) to BDT 7,093mn here (ratio exactly 1.6): the Statement of Changes in Equity shows this is a combined rights share issue (BDT 2,217mn) plus bonus share issue (BDT 443mn) during the quarter, not a data error (4,433 + 2,217 + 443 = 7,093). See the sibling 2014_Q1.json period_note for a data-quality flag regarding this bank's separately-filed 2013_Q4.json total_assets figure, independently reconfirmed by this filing's own Dec-2013 comparative column (171,902 solo / 185,576 consolidated, matching 2014_Q1's comparative exactly).

source.source_page_lines: Single-page dense infographic filing: 'Statement of Financial Position as at 30 September 2014 (Unaudited)' (solo, column 2) and 'Statement of Comprehensive Income for the period ended 30 September 2014' (solo, column 3, below the consolidated P&L); 'Consolidated Statement of Financial Position' (column 1) and 'Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income' (column 3 top) read for cross-reference only; 'Performance Highlights of BRAC Bank Limited as of September 30, 2014' box (bottom right, columns 3-4) for capital/ratio figures.
